rationale: The specific edge that justified entry — heaviest volume of the sequence pressing offers to fresh highs — has evaporated: price has been pinned in a 3-cent range for over 30 minutes while 1-minute volume contracted to roughly a tenth of entry-time levels and MFE stalled at 0.13%, meaning the momentum thesis is stale with no confirming headline and a weak tape still weighing. Structure has not broken (VWAP and flag low intact), so there is no mechanical basis to flip short; exiting at essentially scratch frees capital and preserves the remaining daily loss budget for a setup with active momentum.
